info.title: Reaya+ API
info.description: Reaya+ backend API. Responses use `{ data, meta? }`; errors use `{ error: { code, message, fields? } }`. Messages are Arabic (`Accept-Language: ar`).

full_text.example: 15 شارع عباس العقاد، الدور 4، شقة 12، مدينة نصر، القاهرة

travel_fee.description: Added to home visits in the searched area (piastres)

discounts.description: What makes up `discount`. Credit (referral rewards) is applied automatically.

payment_method.description: card / wallet need the card_payment flag. When the quote has payment_required false (total 0, fully covered by a package and / or credit) this is ignored and the booking gets payment_method "covered".

discounts.description: What makes up `discount`. Credit (referral rewards) is applied automatically.

amount.description: Signed piastres: + platform owes you, − you owe the platform

commission_deducted.description: Commission on cash bookings, taken from this payout

commission_paid.description: Commission you paid from the app in this period

discounts_reimbursed.description: Promo / package / credit discounts on cash visits — the platform bears them

get.summary: Liveness + database status
Readiness for load balancers / uptime monitors: 200 when MongoDB and Redis answer within 2 s, otherwise 503
Scheduled jobs (booking deadlines, reminders, suspension lifts, document check): 200 when each ran recently, 503 when one has gone silent — point an alert at it

post.summary: Send a login code by SMS. Limits: 1/min and 3/10 min per phone, 10/hour per IP.
Verify the code: a session for existing users, a registration token for new numbers
Finish sign-up. Authorization: Bearer <registration_token> (from /auth/otp/verify)
Exchange a refresh token for a new pair. Each refresh token works once — never refresh in parallel.
End this session (and unregister the device push token if given)
Send a code to the new phone number
Confirm the code and switch the account to the new number

Mark the other party's messages as read (they get message.read)
Start a card / wallet checkout for my unpaid booking or package purchase (also returned by POST /bookings and POST /packages/{id}/subscribe). Open checkout_url; the result arrives by webhook.

get.summary: All bookings of the organization (pending ones are its queue), by visit time
Other organizations' / providers' requests offered to this organization after their deadline. Take one by assigning a free staff member (first to take it wins).
Booking details. The patient’s name, phone and address appear once a staff member is assigned; never notes or medical data.
Staff sorted by availability then rating; unavailable ones flagged `available: false` with the reason (area, service, preferred gender, busy…)

post.summary: Assign a staff member — the organization accepts at once. 409 SLOT_UNAVAILABLE if they’re busy or don’t cover it; 409 ASSIGNMENT_DEADLINE_PASSED after the deadline.
Change the assigned staff member of an accepted booking (the previous one loses access and the chat)
"Send to all suitable": offers it to every eligible free staff member until the deadline; first to accept wins
Decline on behalf of the organization: its own request goes straight to other providers (if the patient allowed it), else it is declined; an offered request is passed on
Cancel an assigned booking before the visit starts (a pending one is declined instead)

get.summary: KPIs for today / the last 7 days / this month, with alerts (unassigned bookings, offers, commission limit)

get.summary: The current terms, privacy and health-data consent texts (with `role`: only those that role must accept at sign-up). Empty until counsel’s wording is published.

get.summary: Every published version of every consent text. Super admins only.

post.summary: Publish a new version of a consent text (never edited afterwards). From then on sign-up requires it and existing users see it as not up to date. Super admins only; audited.

get.summary: My clinics (independent doctors), with my hours and settings at each

delete.summary: Remove a clinic (and my hours there)

post.summary: Send the clinic for review (needs a licence). Bookable only once approved.
